test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Find the effective price percentage of the marked price after three consecutive discounts of 18%, 24% and 18%. (Rounded up to two decimal places.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the **Marked Price (MP)** be 100.

Successive Multiplier = (100 − 18)% × (100 − 24)% × (100 − 18)%.

Effective Price % = 100 × 0.82 × 0.76 × 0.82.

Effective Price % = 100 × 0.511024.

Effective Price % ≈ 51.10%.

**∴ The correct answer is 51.10%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Three consecutive discounts d₁ = 18%, d₂ = 24%, and d₃ = 18%.

**Formulas:** Selling Price (SP) = MP × (1 − d₁/100) × (1 − d₂/100) × (1 − d₃/100).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5bf5278ad1f501eca780213864b8edcdff14d6760a640046779deae80a88860.png] 

⇒ Assume **Marked Price** = 100.

⇒ Price after 1st discount = 100 − 18 = 82.

⇒ Price after 2ⁿd discount = 82 − (24% of 82) = 82 − 19.68 = 62.32.

⇒ Price after 3rd discount = 62.32 − (18% of 62.32) = 62.32 − 11.2176 = 51.1024.

⇒ **Effective Price Percentage** = (Final Price ÷ MP) × 100 = 51.10%.

**∴ The correct answer is 51.10%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discounts

When multiple discounts are applied one after another, the net discount is calculated on the reducing balance. Formula for two discounts: a + b − (ab ÷ 100).

Effective Price

The effective price is the final amount paid by the customer after all **consecutive discounts** have been subtracted from the **Marked Price**.</p
